featured_reviews.name: AmitD
featured_reviews.review_text:
Worst Experience at This Motor Training School
- The instructor (driver) was rude and lacked basic etiquette.
- If you ask questions, he responds harshly, making it difficult for introverts to clarify doubts.
- The instructor (driver) constantly asks for money as "Guru Dakshina," which becomes quite annoying.
- Their focus is only on collecting money rather than providing proper training to pass the RTO test. They don’t even teach essential skills like reverse Parking, which is required for the test.
- During my RTO test in Virar, 5-6 learner drivers appeared for the test, and none of them passed. In contrast, I observed that learner drivers from Dinesh Motor Driving School had a 100% pass rate.

featured_reviews.name: Ankit
featured_reviews.review_text:
I would recommend to try a better driving school in same locality.
Most of them are the same, but my experience here was not good.
Firstly they want you to come as per their convenience and your schedule doesnt matter.
Secondly they say half an hour of 4 kms, however they neither train for half an hour nor they will teach u driving for 4 kms.

In my case, they used to finish my training in 10-15 mins and not more thn 2 kms.

None of training teachers are good all are doing their part time job and want to just finish in 10 mins.

I regret spending 3k and wasting my time at this training institute.
Owner is soft spoken guy, however the kind of training they give is pathetic.

I will now have to either join another driving institue to learn or buy a second hand car to learn driving.

Will never recommend this training institue to anyone.

featured_reviews.name: Shubham Singh
featured_reviews.review_text:
I recently completed my two-wheeler training at Dhara Driving School, and it was truly a wonderful experience. As a beginner, I was quite nervous at first, but Dhara Mam’s calm and patient teaching style made everything feel easy and comfortable. She explains every step clearly, from basic balance to handling real road situations, and never rushes the learning process. What I appreciated the most was how she builds confidence gradually—she corrects mistakes gently and ensures you actually understand what you're doing rather than just memorizing steps.

Her professionalism and dedication really stand out. She is punctual, supportive, and genuinely focused on making sure her students become safe and confident riders. Safety is always her priority, and she teaches responsible riding habits along with practical skills. By the end of my training, I felt confident enough to ride independently, which I never thought would be possible so soon. I highly recommend Dhara Driving School to anyone looking to learn a two-wheeler—Dhara Mam is an amazing instructor and makes the entire learning journey enjoyable and stress-free.

featured_reviews.name: Amit Murudkar
featured_reviews.review_text:
I am from Vasai but currently working in Pune, and I needed to get my car re-registration done at Virar RTO. Most driving schools refused to take up the work because I didn’t have the RC, which made things quite challenging.
At that time, I contacted Dhara Ma’am. She completely understood my situation and explained the entire process clearly over the call. After visiting the RTO, she handled everything efficiently and completed my vehicle re-registration and RC-related process in a single day.
Her service is truly unique, trustworthy, and highly professional. The level of detailing and dedication she shows is impressive—a real game changer.
Highly recommended for anyone looking for reliable and hassle-free RTO services!
